items.q: How much can I earn by referring a friend?
items.a: You can earn up to ₹5,000 when a friend joins. The amount can differ for current students and for people who are not enrolled.

items.q: Does my friend get something too?
items.a: Yes. Your friend gets a welcome benefit when they join using your referral.

items.q: How do I refer a friend?
items.a: Share your referral code, and ask your friend to use it while signing up or on the enquiry form.

items.q: Which courses can I refer friends to?
items.a: Any eBuddha Digitech course, including the Bhopal course and the online course.

items.q: What if my friend does not use my code at sign-up?
items.a: Contact our team as early as you can. Rewards are linked to the referral code used while signing up or on the enquiry form.

items.q: Where do I ask a question about my reward?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp at +91 84619 58162 or email ebuddhadigitech@gmail.com with your name and your friend's name.
